films.title: Electra
films.description: Cacoyannis films the Oresteia's core — the son returned, the axe, the mother — in stark Greek light.

music.title: Elektra
music.description: Strauss' one-act nightmare of waiting and the axe — Hofmannsthal's Electra until Orestes strikes.

popCulture.title: Oresteia
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus' only surviving trilogy — Agamemnon, the Libation Bearers, the Eumenides — still the West's map of blood-guilt turning into law.

popCulture.title: Electra (Sophocles play)
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' Electra waiting at Mycenae — sister and recognition before the matricide the Oresteia made inevitable.

popCulture.title: Electra (Euripides play)
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' rural Electra — the same revenge, colder and more uneasy, the Oresteia's blood without Aeschylus' civic closure.
